correctness.rationale: Classical uniqueness of the inscribed regular n-gon maximizer plus compactness localizes the event. Ordered-gap density is exactly n! times the last gap divided by (2pi)^n, and radial density is the product of 2r_i. The area has an n-variable positive radial linear form and an (n-1)-variable positive definite angular quadratic form with Gram determinant n; the beta-ball integral and radial simplex volume yield exactly C_n. The Taylor remainder is O(epsilon^(3/2)) uniformly on the O(epsilon) radial/O(sqrt(epsilon)) angular cap, giving relative O(sqrt(epsilon)) error. Symbolic exact coefficient checks and independently seeded enlarged-domain simulations from delivered code corroborate but do not replace the proof.

originality.rationale: The new result is the complete sharp upper-end law for every fixed n>=4 independent area-uniform interior disk samples. A previously recorded n=3 disk-triangle theorem already proves the corresponding n=3 upper-tail coefficient and a stronger marked conditional limit; that case is not novel here and is provided only as a consistency check. For n>=4, the formula adds n radial boundary defects to the published angular-only boundary-sampling law, changing the exponent from (n-1)/2 to (3n-1)/2. Relevant prior primary results were inspected. Targeted semantic search and accessible own-history comparison identified no higher-order interior law. Historical priority remains uncertain.
residual_risks: Worldwide historical priority is not certified by a finite set of semantic and literature searches.
A broad general theorem on smooth-body upper extremes or a less searchable equivalent formula might exist under different terminology.
Complete text of the broad Paouris–Pivovarov volume paper was not inspected; its displayed model is materially different.
Any future dependent maximum-over-subsets limit law requires separate Poisson/dependency checks and is not part of this result.
The n=3 specialization is already covered by an earlier exact result; only the fixed-n>=4 family is newly assessed.

value.rationale: The complete higher-order fixed-n>=4 upper endpoint of the area-uniform disk polygon hull is a natural stochastic-geometric invariant. It requires n independent radial boundary penalties and the (n-1)-dimensional angular Hessian determinant, yielding a structurally uniform gamma coefficient and precise exponent for arbitrarily large fixed vertex orders. This is a substantive higher-order extension of the previously solved n=3 case, not a repeated triangular constant or a routine numerical increment. It provides natural local information for maximal-area polygon subset problems without claiming a dependent-extremes theorem.
